description: Runs `npm run typecheck` before every git commit so type errors never slip through. `npm run build` is intentionally excluded — it depends on .env.local (Supabase env vars) that fresh worktrees don't have, and would false-block commits; build verification stays part of the manual PR quality-bar checklist / CI. SessionStart runs .claude/scripts/worktree-bootstrap.sh, which gives a fresh git worktree node_modules (APFS copy-on-write clone from the main checkout) and a symlinked .env.local — without it, npm test/format and that typecheck hook fail in every worktree.
